correctness.rationale: For all a,b,d,h,k,s>0 on k0=m=s and h²<ab, direct symbolic differentiation of V=(x²+y²+(s/k)u²)/2 gives Vdot=-(a x²-2hxy+b y²). This quadratic form is positive definite, so V is nonincreasing, bounding x,y,u for all forward time; stable scalar zdot=-dz+xy is bounded by variation of constants, excluding finite escape. LaSalle on the precompact trajectory yields omega limit in x=y=0, whose invariant core forces u=0; on the remaining z-axis zdot=-dz, so all states tend to origin. Local stability follows from small V and the forced z inequality. For compactly supported invariant measures, integrated Vdot=0 gives exact moment equality, Q positive definite forces x=y=0 almost surely; support invariance forces u=0 and integrating derivative z² then z=0. This proves unique compact invariant measure delta_0. We do not claim h²=ab or unequal feedback. Independent SymPy identity residual is zero; assigned seven Git blob identities yield source-tree SHA a2130de8f355eed896ab7a13b908c189645e3cc7.

value.rationale: The equal dual-feedback slice is the very one used at k0=m=0.8 in the original Li–Cui numerical experiments, yet omitted by that paper’s k0>m boundedness theorem. A genuinely nonlinear all-initial-data convergence region and absence of any nonzero compact recurrent invariant measure are meaningful dynamical conclusions, stronger than local equilibrium stability and a numerical time series. Their motivation is specific to the exact published vector field, not a random parameter slice. This is a limited sufficient global-stability certificate, not complete phase classification.
residual_risks: The quadratic cancellation is short and could be considered an elementary case of generalized damping/passivity techniques; the value derives from solving a concrete source-identified equal-feedback gap, not from a new general method.
There is no sharpness or complete dynamical classification at/above h²=ab.

limitations: No assertion at h^2=ab or for unequal feedback coefficients; the necessary compact-recurrence condition is not sufficient.
Complete Liu et al. (2010) foundational article unavailable through lawful access; only abstract/provenance comparison inspected.
